Analyse One Route Block

Source: R/route_analysis.R
ck_route_block.Rd

Analyse One Route Block

Usage

ck_route_block(
  data,
  def,
  block,
  group_vars,
  weight_column,
  sm_separator,
  top_n,
  label_row,
  top_countries = 0,
  full_sample = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

The dataset, label row removed and grouping variables renamed.

def

The block definition from ck_route_blocks().

block

The block name.

group_vars

Disaggregation variables.

weight_column

Weights column, or NULL.

sm_separator

The select_multiple separator.

top_n

Places per country that get a section of their own.

label_row

The ONA label row, or NULL.

top_countries

Countries that get a section of their own, most respondents first; 0 for all.

full_sample

Logical. Report the country ranking and the respondent_full_sample questions out of every respondent (see run_route_analysis()). Default TRUE.

Value

The block's rows of the run_route_analysis() result, or NULL.
